# qualified super method reference

class C { java.util.function.Supplier<String> m() { return C.super::toString; } }

==>

Program(
  ClassDeclaration(
    class,
    Definition,
    ClassBody(
      MethodDeclaration(
        GenericType(
          ScopedTypeName(ScopedTypeName(ScopedTypeName(TypeName, TypeName), TypeName), TypeName),
          TypeArguments(TypeName)),
        Definition,
        FormalParameters,
        Block(ReturnStatement(return, MethodReference(Identifier, super, Identifier)))))))

# enclosing class super method reference

class C { class Inner { java.util.function.Supplier<String> m() { return C.super::toString; } } }

==>

Program(
  ClassDeclaration(
    class,
    Definition,
    ClassBody(
      ClassDeclaration(
        class,
        Definition,
        ClassBody(
          MethodDeclaration(
            GenericType(
              ScopedTypeName(ScopedTypeName(ScopedTypeName(TypeName, TypeName), TypeName), TypeName),
              TypeArguments(TypeName)),
            Definition,
            FormalParameters,
            Block(ReturnStatement(return, MethodReference(Identifier, super, Identifier)))))))))

# qualified super method reference with type arguments

class Base { <T> T id() { return null; } }
class C extends Base { java.util.function.Supplier<String> m() { return C.super::<String>id; } }

==>

Program(
  ClassDeclaration(
    class,
    Definition,
    ClassBody(
      MethodDeclaration(
        TypeParameters(TypeParameter(Definition)),
        TypeName,
        Definition,
        FormalParameters,
        Block(ReturnStatement(return, null))))),
  ClassDeclaration(
    class,
    Definition,
    Superclass(extends, TypeName),
    ClassBody(
      MethodDeclaration(
        GenericType(
          ScopedTypeName(ScopedTypeName(ScopedTypeName(TypeName, TypeName), TypeName), TypeName),
          TypeArguments(TypeName)),
        Definition,
        FormalParameters,
        Block(
          ReturnStatement(
            return,
            MethodReference(Identifier, super, TypeArguments(TypeName), Identifier)))))))
